title: Your Loan EMIs and Savings: What the RBI's Upcoming Meeting Could Mean
description: India's central bank, the RBI, is holding a key meeting from October 5-7, 2026. They will decide on the 'repo rate,' which influences all other interest rates.

faq.q: What is the current repo rate?
faq.a: The repo rate currently stands at 5.25%.

faq.q: When was the last time the RBI changed the repo rate?
faq.a: The RBI has kept the repo rate unchanged in its last four policy reviews. The last time the repo rate was increased was in February 2023.

faq.q: What is the RBI's inflation target?
faq.a: The RBI aims to keep retail inflation (based on the Consumer Price Index) within a band of 2% to 6%, with a medium-term target of 4%.

faq.q: How often does the MPC meet?
faq.a: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meets six times a year, typically every two months, to review monetary policy.
